summary: Around Pond RV Park: stored website is a parked domain, operator now aroundpondrvparks.net (Firefly). DROP CANDIDATE on two counts: only 25 of 182 RV sites across its two Firefly properties take nightly stays (Park 25/104, Resort 0/78), and the nightly rate is $51.39 with no Good Sam listing and no gateway within 40 km. Full hookups 30/50 A, showers confirmed; pond value plausible on imagery but site numbers not tied.
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (long-stay share): the Park's Firefly 'Nightly' search lists 104 RV sites and 79 answer 'Requested reservation type not accepted'; only 25 (14, 49-51, 53-56, 65-70, 72, 74-77, 79-84) take a nightly stay. The second Firefly property on the same site, 'Around Pond RV Resort' (78 sites S02-S95), refuses nightly on all four dates tried (Dec 2026, Jan, Apr, Jun 2027). Nightly share ~14% of 182 (24% of the Park's own list). No tent sites listed. Google 4.3 over 250 reviews; RV Life 4*/$$.

DROP CANDIDATE (price gate): '$51.39 avg per night' on every nightly site, Dec 2026 and Jun 2027 alike - over US$50. Firefly's list price normally excludes tax (no tax line shown), so treated as before tax; if it were tax-inclusive at Greene County's ~9.75% it would be ~$46.80. Not a Good Sam Park (no match in the directory cache; no discounts on the entry); gateways.py: none within 40 km (Asheville 86 km, GSMNP 95 km); no member discount posted.

WEBSITE https://aroundpondrvparks.com/ -> https://aroundpondrvparks.net/ (old domain refuses https and shows a Network Solutions parked 'Under Construction' page on http; Google's listing links the .net, which carries the same phone and address).
PHONE '' -> 423-234-0229 (operator site, both Firefly pages and Google).

WATERFRONT pond (kept, flag): the pond is ~105 x 95 m (~0.8 ha) on Esri imagery, and the southern loop's pads sit ~15-25 m from its north shore over open mowed grass, matching the stored evidence. The operator advertises 'Premium sites available with direct pond access'. Neither the site nor Firefly has a map, so I could not name which site numbers front the pond or whether any of them are among the 25 nightly sites. Under 'defaults down' the reviewer may want 'pond view' unless pond-side nightly sites can be named; moot if the entry is dropped.
SITES: allstays-derived max_rig_ft 100 replaced by Firefly's per-site fits (nightly sites 30-108 ft; site 74 only 30 ft). count set to the 25 nightly sites.
UNREAD: Firefly's invisible reCAPTCHA refused 3 of 8 searches (no captcha was attempted); no rate for the monthly/'Ongoing' type was read; Firefly gave no per-site photos tied to the pond.
